# videopodcast-magic

**Read `AGENTS.md` in the root of this repository before suggesting
anything. It is the source, and this file is only a pointer to it.**

It says what the program is for, what may never leave this machine, how
the tests are run and why they are built the way they are. Nothing is
repeated here on purpose: a second copy of the rules is a second copy to
keep true, and this project has already had one set of rules standing in
four wordings at once.

`CLAUDE.md` beside it is the same pointer for a different reader, and
`CONTRIBUTING.md` is the ten-minute version for somebody working from
outside.
